title: VPG Engine — Moves
description: Schema for the move catalog. A move's slot_ids list the slots it is eligible for; its groups record which slot groups those came from.

schema_version.description: Increment when the schema shape changes in a breaking way. 3 uses string-encoded lists, booleans, and null values, separate actor/target animation filenames, and slot animation overrides.

field_definitions.description: Human-readable documentation of each field. Not validated structurally.

move_id.description: Move identifier. Looser than other ids — allows leading digits (e.g. '450_splash', '10_punch') because real wrestling moves use them. Must be lowercase, digits, and underscores only.

position.description: Must mirror the position enum in move-slots.schema.json.

power.description: Power grade S (highest) through G (lowest), or the literal string "null" for moves that do no damage.

feature.description: "pin" for a pin attempt, "submit" for a submission attempt, or the literal string "null" for neither.

groups.description: Comma-separated slot group ids recording where this move was drawn from. Descriptive only; slot_ids determines eligibility. Cross-file integrity requires separate validation.

slot_ids.description: Comma-separated authoritative slot ids this move can fill. Cross-file integrity requires separate validation.

actor_animation_id.description: Animation filename for the wrestler performing the move, or the string "null".

target_animation_id.description: Animation filename for the target wrestler, or the string "null".

slot_animation_overrides.description: Empty string when there are no overrides; otherwise semicolon-separated slot_id:animation_id pairs. Animation values are GLB filenames or the string "null".

id_list.description: Nonempty comma-separated snake_case identifiers. Existence and duplicate checks require separate validation.

boolean_string.description: Boolean encoded as a string in the version-3 catalog.

animation_id.description: GLB animation filename, or the literal string "null" when no animation is assigned.
